---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new capability or improvement
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ""
---

## Problem / motivation

What are you trying to do, and what's getting in the way? A clear description of
the problem this feature would solve.

## Proposed solution

What would you like ccal to do? Describe the behavior, new flag, endpoint, or
option you have in mind.

## Alternatives considered

Any alternative approaches or workarounds you've thought about or tried.

## Additional context

Anything else — links, examples from other tools, or how this fits ccal's goal
of being a thin OpenAI-compatible adapter over the local `claude` CLI.
